custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the junction where the hammer-head connects to the main body; AI often creates a seamless 'neck' lacking the distinct muscular ridge found in real specimens. Verify if gill slits are five distinct vertical lines or a merged blurry patch. Use geometric depth analysis to confirm if the central indentation on the hammer head is a true 3D feature or a 2D texture artifact.
image_description: A side-profile view of a hammerhead shark swimming in deep blue water, facing left. The image captures the anterior half of the shark, prominently displaying the cephalofoil (hammer-shaped head), gill slits, pectoral fin, and first dorsal fin. The caudal fin is not visible within the frame.
